method: Exact source GO + mode + line overrides. All other joins require literal GO_NR = GTFS agency_id and identical line/mode. An identity match only supplies candidate geometry; every directed stop pattern still has to pass the matcher. GTFS direction_id is never equated to RICHTUNG.
